items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Mr Pastraudis... came to Paris and contacted Burns to form an orchestra for his place... We therefore decided to form a group and keep it a secret.

ctx.x: I had really enjoyed my stay in Bombay and I suppose that if I had been offered the opportunity to go back there with a group formed in Paris, I may have accepted. But I didn't have any desire to go there alone and it was not because I was afraid of anything. I refused the offer.

In December, Mr Pastraudis, the owner of the Monseigneur in Alexandria, Egypt, came to Paris and contacted Burns to form an orchestra for his place. When he did not want to take Willie Lewis again, I never knew, unless that he had contacted Willie and he could not get out of the contract he had at the Coliseum.
